findings.title: W4 commissioning w4-normal: declared step outcomes observed
findings.inference: Assigned carton sorted to exit A with WCS offer acknowledgement, PLC completion and peer acknowledgement through the isolated child.
assumptions: Preserved Muse world 0.5.0; one carton at a time; M8 build 8001/interface 1 declared timers
findings.uncertainty: Commissioning of the isolated runtime path only; no controller coverage, Wonder decision or HMI-operation claim.

findings.title: W4 commissioning w4-leases: declared step outcomes observed
findings.inference: Child-enforced leases returned evidence-backed receipts; met condition and expiry held the world while PLC scans continued; late decisions were not applied.
assumptions: Preserved Muse world 0.5.0; one carton at a time; M8 build 8001/interface 1 declared timers
findings.uncertainty: Commissioning of the isolated runtime path only; no controller coverage, Wonder decision or HMI-operation claim.

findings.title: W4 commissioning w4-fault: declared step outcomes observed
findings.inference: Declared drive overload produced PLC fault 10 with motor off; after clearing the world fault an explicit operator Reset returned the controller to Stopped.
assumptions: Preserved Muse world 0.5.0; one carton at a time; M8 build 8001/interface 1 declared timers
findings.uncertainty: Commissioning of the isolated runtime path only; no controller coverage, Wonder decision or HMI-operation claim.
